verifications.note: p.35, 'TAPROOT ROCKIES MIDSTREAM LLC – (9/18) Project: Taproot Rockies Midstream System ... Project includes the construction and operation of a multi-product midstream system in the DJ Basin comprised of natural gas, crude oil and produced water gathering, natural gas treating and processing and fresh water supply.' Names the same project gem.wiki's own background section cites this exact PDF for (already accepted on this row for Location/Operator/Start/Status), and states outright that natural gas is one of the commodities/services the system handles.

'Based in Dallas, Texas, Taproot’s capabilities include natural gas gathering, compression, treating and processing, oil gathering and transportation, produced water disposal, fresh water supply, condensate treating and blending and natural gas liquids products marketing.' Independently corroborates natural gas as one of the fluids/services of Taproot's DJ Basin midstream system (the same system this article discusses under the 'existing Baja System' name in its next sentence).

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded Fuel='Gas' confirmed by 2 independent sources: the 2018 Pipeline News PDF (already on this row for Location/Operator/Start/Status, describing the Taproot Rockies Midstream/Baja system as handling 'natural gas, crude oil and produced water gathering, natural gas treating and processing') and the 2020 Rigzone piece (already on this row for Operator), which separately states Taproot's DJ Basin capabilities include 'natural gas gathering, compression, treating and processing' alongside oil/water. Both name the system by its Taproot Rockies Midstream/company identity rather than literally saying 'Baja' -- the same identity gem.wiki's own background section and this row's prior Location/Operator/Start/Status refs already treat as this pipeline, so tier is medium rather than high (multi-commodity system, gas is one of several fluids, not the line's sole or headline product per any source read).

No source found stating or supporting PipelineType='transmission'. Searched and read to exhaustion: the PN1018 PDF already on this row (describes the system only as a 'multi-product midstream system... comprised of natural gas, crude oil and produced water GATHERING, natural gas treating and processing and fresh water supply' -- never 'transmission'); energyspectrum.com/investments/taproot-energy-partners/ (owner Energy Spectrum Capital's own portfolio page, which labels the asset's 'Asset Type' explicitly as 'Gathering & Processing' and describes it as 'crude oil and produced water gathering and transportation'); the already-on-row Rigzone article (Taproot's DJ Basin capabilities described as 'natural gas gathering, compression, treating and processing, oil gathering and transportation'); and ogj.com's Rattlesnake-extension piece (calls the Baja system a 'multiservice midstream system' built to gather/transport crude to a redelivery point, again not 'transmission'). Two of the businesswire.com seed citations (20200601005083, 20190916005915) could not be checked this pass -- both returned Akamai 'Access Denied' (not a 404/410, so not treated as dead), and the Wayback availability API 429'd on both attempts and was not retried further within this pass. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: every source actually read for this row -- including the owner's own investor-facing description -- characterizes this system as gathering/midstream, never transmission; recommend an Update pass revisit whether PipelineType should be 'gathering' rather than 'transmission' (controlled vocab: transmission/gathering/distribution), rather than leaving 'transmission' uncited.
